summary: Host: a subscription page now waits on its session wakeup until the page deadline instead of re-sampling every 250 ms (4 owner dispatches + one wire batch per 250 ms), so an idle page costs its opening and closing batch only; a missing watcher (capacity) keeps the bounded poll. Android: HostClient.inspect keeps the authenticated TLS session for consecutive 3 s subscription pages (fresh reducer per page from the held projection, 15 s watchdog re-armed per page) and returns to PairingViewModel's reconnect loop only after a 60 s reuse window (SubscriptionSession), so an idle phone handshakes at most once a minute; a reconnect resumes from the held cursor as before.

notes: src/remote/listener.rs (also owned) needed no change: ZE-541's authenticated slots and the existing 30 s per-request / 7 s per-page host deadlines already carry consecutive subscribe requests on one connection. wakeup.rs is unchanged; subscription.rs waits on the signal directly. View changes that never notify the session wakeup are now picked up at the next page (<= 3 s) rather than within 250 ms; durable turns, prompt/worker progress, live text, approvals, terminal and workspace changes all notify today. The Android reuse window is a bounded 60 s rather than unlimited so the connection, OperationDeadline (90 s with subscribe) and the full workspace re-read stay bounded; a user command still cancels the subscription and opens its own connection as before. New file android/app/src/test/java/zenpi/SubscriptionSessionTest.kt (outside the owned path list, test only). tests/remote_host_e2e.rs: authenticated_workspace_list split into authenticated_stream + workspace_list for reuse.
